findings.was: is_retryable() was a deny-list; STALE_STATE was retryable and a future ErrorKind member would have been retryable by default.
findings.now: Explicit allow-list of TRANSIENT_FAILURE, PROVIDER_FAILURE and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. STALE_STATE fails closed. validate_failure() rejects a STALE_STATE record marked retryable.

findings.was: assert_secret_free() and redact_secrets() inspected top-level keys only. The earlier test payload even contained nested={'token':'abc'} while asserting only the top-level key, so the leak case was present in the data but never asserted.
findings.now: Both traverse nested mappings and common sequences recursively, reporting dotted paths such as 'nested.token' and 'attempts[1].authorization'. Redaction preserves non-secret structure, container types and mapping key types.
findings.evidence: test_nested_secret_keys_are_rejected_and_redacted, test_secret_in_sequence_of_mappings_is_rejected_and_redacted, test_redaction_preserves_tuple_containers; mutations M8, M8b and M8c caught.

findings.was: evidence_graph_from_legacy_bundle() silently dropped unresolvable causal_refs, and the A2 test explicitly approved that lineage loss, converting missing causal evidence into a valid-looking graph.
findings.now: Fails closed with a ValueError naming the proof and the unresolved refs. A partially resolvable proof still fails, so one good ref cannot excuse a lost one. A bundle with no causal refs remains valid - absent lineage is not broken lineage.
findings.evidence: test_unresolvable_causal_refs_fail_closed, test_partially_unresolvable_causal_refs_fail_closed, test_no_causal_refs_is_valid; mutations M9 and M9b caught.

correctionDelta.regressionsIntroduced: none - the three previously green invariants that the review confirmed as valid (cycle detection, graph fingerprinting, carry-forward) remain covered and their mutants M1/M2/M2b/M3 still pass

decisions: Retry classification is an explicit allow-list (TRANSIENT_FAILURE, PROVIDER_FAILURE, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) rather than a deny-list, so STALE_STATE fails closed and any ErrorKind member added later is non-retryable by default.

The secret-safe telemetry boundary is recursive over nested mappings and common sequences rather than rejecting nested structures outright, so telemetry can still carry structured non-secret payloads.
Unresolved legacy causal_refs fail closed with ValueError rather than being dropped, because a dropped ref converts missing causal evidence into a valid-looking graph.
The legacy evidence bridge is duck-typed by value so the kernel never imports product modules, preserving the dependency direction.

carry_forward() verifies the node's own subject fingerprint in addition to its dependency fingerprints. This is stricter than the literal S00 wording and deliberate: promoting a node whose own subject changed would assert a proof over changed content.
Duplicate ProofState definitions in media, audio_narrative and content_brand are NOT removed; the bridge adapts them by value and migration belongs to each module's own shard.
primitives.py and envelopes.py were not modified; the ErrorKind taxonomy was not reopened.
Envelope adapters (KERNEL-ENVELOPE-ADAPTERS) were deliberately left out of scope as they are not one of the six required S00 implementation items.
WO-S00 ran only in an isolated Python 3.14 venv outside the repository; system python 3.12 (which resolves ugas to UGAS V1) was not used for any command.
Evidence was published on the governed branch feat/wo-s00-kernel-sync; the canonical branch planning/m01-replan was not advanced by the executor.
Remaining CODEX-TASK markers were annotated with what is still open rather than deleted, so no PREPROGRAMMED surface reads as IMPLEMENTED.
